newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via $1.5 billion customer RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via $1.5 billion customer RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the U.S. banking system on Tuesday via $1.5 billion customer repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman said.
Analysts said the action had no policy implications for Tuesday's Federal Open Market Commmittee meeting.
"The operation has no policy significance," said Steve Ricchiuto, chief financial economist at BZW Securities.
At 1130 EDT/1530 GMT fed funds were trading at 5-3/8 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
